mandate: C407 — test the cross-sectional intraday XSRANK: CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK-PERSISTENCE PROFILE x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Panel rank matrix: for every bar s, rank all 10 symbols' returns mapped to (rank − 5.5)/10. XSRANK scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing cross-sectional ranks Z=rk_i[t-W+1..t]: rank_ac1=corr(Z[1:],Z[:-1]); rank_ac4=corr(Z[4:],Z[:-4]); rank_ac_decay=rank_ac1−rank_ac4. NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in Z, or a lag leg has <3 pairs / zero variance / not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 3 real (rank_ac1_dev, rank_ac4_dev, rank_ac_decay_dev) + 3 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar rank window or a leg has <3 pairs / zero variance / not finite).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing cross-sectional ranks Z=rk_i[t-W+1..t]; panel rank matrix built per bar by ranking all 10 symbols' returns mapped to (rank − 5.5)/10; rank_ac1=corr(Z[1:],Z[:-1]); rank_ac4=corr(Z[4:],Z[:-4]); rank_ac_decay=rank_ac1−rank_ac4.
methodology.signals: rank_ac1/rank_ac4/rank_ac_decay over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 6 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.xsrank_vectorization_note: panel rank matrix built once per grid (per-bar argsort across 10 assets); sliding_window_view(R,256) with sum-identity autocorrelation for lags 1 and 4; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit panel rank matrix and np.corrcoef on aligned segments with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests. Per-asset metric computation parallelized via ProcessPoolExecutor.
